name: Stryker Ten
original_name: ストライカー てん
source:
He's a Stryker Zero mate named Stryker Ten, also knowed as Ten. His body is a full machine, consuming only oil.

[spoiler]His real name is Ichimonji Souichirou, the real father of Sayaka and creator of the Sistem Stryker.
